steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-05, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 26.6 | 4.30 | 4.30
2 | 119.1 | 2.37 | 6.67
3 | 340.4 | 0.77 | 7.44
4 | 640.3 | 0.77 | 8.21
5 | 2441.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-05, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station H-05, Survey Area H**

The VES interpretation at H-05 resolves a five-layer resistivity sequence: 26.6 Ω·m (0–4.30 m), 119.1 Ω·m (4.30–6.67 m), 340.4 Ω·m (6.67–7.44 m), 640.3 Ω·m (7.44–8.21 m), and a basal layer of 2441.4 Ω·m (effectively infinite depth). Resistivity increases monotonically with depth throughout the section, with no resistivity inversions present.

For curve-type classification, each successive triplet of layers (1-2-3, 2-3-4, 3-4-5) shows r1 < r2 < r3, yielding "A" for all three groups, i.e., AAA, which by convention may be written simply as "A" (not "AA"). The on-file classification of "AA-type" does not match the expected 3-letter (or single-letter "A") notation for a 5-layer section and should be corrected to "A" (or "AAA").

Recommend updating interpretation file before drilling design finalization.
